newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN LATE RUBBER STABLE IN QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN LATE RUBBER STABLE IN QUIET TRADE.

text.p: Indonesian tyre grade SIR20 rubber prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday, with buyers showing little interest amid bearish sentiment, traders said.
They said October shipment rubber was done at 42.25 cents/lb fob Padang, while December shipment was traded at 42.75 cents. Buying interest in other centers remained thin.
"The market was generally quiet, although there was some buying interest but the bids were well below the offer prices and sellers did not seem keen," one trader said.
Traders said players were also closely monitoring the fall of the Indonesian rupiah against the U.S. dollar, adding that buyers were taking the opportunity to pressure prices.
"They are saying Indonesian prices should be lower because of the stronger U.S. dollar," one trader said. "But at this point, sellers would rather hold than sell at lower prices."
Traders said October shipment SIR20 was mostly offered unchanged at 43.50 cents/lb fob Medan and 43.00-43.25 cents fob Palembang and Padang.
